title: Drought, Famine, and Sword

questions.question: The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah concerning the...
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 14:1 (ESV): "The word of the Lord that came to Jeremiah concerning the drought:"

questions.question: "Judah mourns, and her... languish; her people lament on the ground, and the cry of Jerusalem goes up."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 14:2 (ESV): "Judah mourns, and her gates languish;"

questions.question: Because of the drought, what do the farmers do in dismay?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 14:4 (ESV): "Because of the ground that is dismayed, since there is no rain on the land, the farmers are ashamed; they cover their heads."

questions.question: And the wild donkeys stand on the bare heights; they pant for... like jackals; their eyes fail because there is no vegetation.
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 14:6 (ESV): "they pant for air like jackals;"

questions.question: "Though our... testify against us, act, O Lord, for your name's sake; for our backslidings are many; we have sinned against you."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 14:7 (ESV): "Though our iniquities testify against us, act, O Lord, for your name's sake;"

questions.question: "O you hope of Israel, its... in time of trouble, why should you be like a stranger in the land, like a traveler who turns aside to tarry for a night?"
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 14:8 (ESV): "O you hope of Israel, its savior in time of trouble,"

questions.question: The Lord says of this people: "They have loved to wander thus; they have not restrained their feet; therefore the Lord does not accept them; now he will remember their... and punish their sins."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 14:10 (ESV): "now he will remember their iniquity and punish their sins."

questions.question: What did the Lord tell Jeremiah NOT to do for the people?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 14:11 (ESV): "The Lord said to me: 'Do not pray for the welfare of this people.'"

questions.question: "Though they fast, I will not hear their cry, and though they offer burnt offering and grain offering, I will not accept them. But I will consume them by the..., by famine, and by pestilence."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 14:12 (ESV): "But I will consume them by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence."

questions.question: Jeremiah tells the Lord that the prophets are saying to the people: "You shall not see the sword, nor shall you have famine, but I will give you assured... in this place."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 14:13 (ESV): "but I will give you assured peace in this place."

questions.question: The Lord replies regarding the prophets: "The prophets are prophesying... in my name. I did not send them, nor did I command them or speak to them."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 14:14 (ESV): "And the Lord said to me: 'The prophets are prophesying lies in my name.'"

questions.question: "Therefore thus says the Lord concerning the prophets who prophesy in my name although I did not send them... By... and... those prophets shall be consumed."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 14:15 (ESV): "By sword and famine those prophets shall be consumed."

questions.question: "And the people to whom they prophesy shall be cast out in the streets of Jerusalem, victims of famine and sword, with none to... them..."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 14:16 (ESV): "with none to bury them—them, their wives, their sons, and their daughters."

questions.question: "Let my eyes run down with... night and day, and let them not cease, for the virgin daughter of my people is smitten with a great wound, with a very grievous blow."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 14:17 (ESV): "Let my eyes run down with tears night and day, and let them not cease,"

questions.question: "Are there any among the... gods of the nations that can bring rain? Or can the heavens give showers? Are you not he, O Lord our God? We set our hope on you, for you do all these things."
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 14:22 (ESV): "Are there any among the false gods of the nations that can bring rain?"

key_verse_text: The Lord said to me: "Do not pray for the welfare of this people. Though they fast, I will not hear their cry, and though they offer burnt offering and grain offering, I will not accept them. But I will consume them by the sword, by famine, and by pestilence."
